text: Internal citations are distinct directed citing-work → cited-work pairs with both endpoints in the Columbia-affiliated 2021–2024 snapshot (all work types); assign each work one OpenAlex field via its primary topic, falling back to highest-scored assigned topic only when primary-topic information is unavailable. Keep unclassified as a separate bucket; count same-field pairs and identify cross-field pairs separately.

Use all 2021–2024 snapshot works regardless of type; require both citation endpoints to join to works, and deduplicate ordered work-ID pairs. Drop identical work-ID self-loops as anomalies if present (none observed); do not filter shared-author citations. Classify by the field mapped from works.primary_topic_id, otherwise use a mapped assigned topic (flagged primary first if available, then highest score, lower rank, ascending topic ID). Use UNCLASSIFIED as a separate field ID for remaining works. Same/cross are defined only for pairs with two classified endpoints; unclassified endpoint pairs remain in overall totals.

The complete field-pair table contains every observed positive-count ordered bucket pair; absent pairs have zero count. Sankey nodes are separate by endpoint role (citing left, cited right), including same-field flows. Independently rank all observed links and classified cross-field links by count descending, then citing field ID and cited field ID ascending; show the top 25 for each, with displayed count and eligible count.
